title: People, family and descriptive adjective agreement

questions.prompt: Complete: « Ma sœur est ___ ». Choose the feminine form of petit.
questions.explanation: Petite adds -e to agree with the feminine singular noun sœur.

questions.prompt: Choose the masculine plural adjective: « Mes cousins sont ___ ».
questions.explanation: Sportifs agrees with the masculine plural noun cousins.

questions.prompt: Complete: « Une voiture ___ ».
questions.explanation: Rouge has the same masculine and feminine singular form.

questions.prompt: Complete: « Mon frère a les yeux ___ ».
questions.explanation: Bleus agrees with masculine plural yeux.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct feminine article: « ___ amie arrive ».
questions.explanation: Une is the feminine singular indefinite article; amie is feminine.

questions.prompt: Complete: « Il a ___ sœur ».
questions.explanation: Sœur is a feminine singular noun, so the indefinite article is une.

questions.prompt: Which phrase agrees correctly with the feminine plural noun filles?
questions.explanation: Gentilles has feminine plural -es agreeing with filles.

questions.prompt: Which adjective is correct with « un garçon »?
questions.explanation: Heureux is the masculine singular form; heureuse is feminine.

questions.prompt: Complete: « Nous avons deux chats ___ ».
questions.explanation: Noirs takes the masculine plural -s for chats.

questions.prompt: Read: « Mon père est grand et ma mère est grande. » What changes?
choices: The adjective agrees with the person described.
The word for father changes gender.
questions.explanation: Grand becomes grande for the feminine noun mère.

questions.prompt: Read: « Léo a un petit frère et deux grandes sœurs. » How many sisters does Léo have?
questions.explanation: Deux grandes sœurs identifies two sisters.

questions.prompt: Read: « Les robes sont vertes, mais le pantalon est noir. » Which clothing is green?
questions.explanation: Vertes agrees with feminine plural robes.

questions.prompt: Read: « Elle est brune et son frère est blond. » Who is blond?
questions.explanation: Son frère est blond directly identifies her brother.

questions.prompt: Read: « Mes parents sont patients. » How many parents are included?
questions.explanation: Parents is plural and patients agrees in the plural.

questions.prompt: Read: « Cette maison est ancienne. » What is described?
questions.explanation: Ancienne is the feminine adjective modifying maison.

questions.prompt: Read: « Mes amies sont françaises. » What does françaises tell you?
choices: The friends are described as French.
The friends are studying French tomorrow.
questions.explanation: Françaises is the feminine plural nationality adjective.

questions.prompt: Read: « La petite fille porte un chapeau rouge. » Which item is red?
questions.explanation: Rouge modifies the noun chapeau.

questions.prompt: Read: « Mon oncle est calme, mais mes cousines sont bruyantes. » Who is noisy?
questions.explanation: Bruyantes agrees with feminine plural cousines.

questions.prompt: Describe one female friend as kind. Which sentence is correct?
questions.explanation: Amie is feminine singular and takes est gentille.

questions.prompt: Two girls are tall. Which sentence is correct?
questions.explanation: Elles needs sont and the feminine plural grandes.

questions.prompt: You have one black cat and the cat is female. Choose the correct description.
questions.explanation: Chatte is feminine singular, taking ma and noire.

questions.prompt: A child describes two brothers as funny. Choose the best sentence.
questions.explanation: Frères is masculine plural; mes, sont and amusants agree.

questions.prompt: You are introducing your grandmother. Which is correct?
questions.explanation: Grand-mère is feminine singular and takes ma.

questions.prompt: A student writes « une fille intelligent ». What is the correction?
questions.explanation: Intelligente agrees with the feminine singular noun fille.

questions.prompt: You are describing several red apples. Which phrase works?
questions.explanation: Pommes is plural and rouge becomes rouges.

questions.prompt: Your two female classmates are tired. Choose the correct sentence.
questions.explanation: With the specified female group, fatiguées is feminine plural.

questions.prompt: A boy introduces his two younger sisters. Which phrase is correct?
questions.explanation: Petites agrees with feminine plural sœurs; mes is plural.
